title: Support
faq_create_character_q: How do I create my character?
faq_create_character_a: After creating your account, you are taken to the character creation screen. Choose your class, roll race and trait (3 tickets each) and set the name.
faq_guild_q: How do I create a guild?
faq_guild_a: Go to the Guild page and click Create Guild. Level, gold and diamonds requirements are shown there — adjustable from the admin panel.
faq_tickets_q: I lost my roll tickets, what now?
faq_tickets_a: Tickets are per account, limited to 3 for race and 3 for trait. New tickets can be granted by support/admin.
faq_bug_q: Where do I report a bug?
faq_bug_a: Use the form below or reach out on the community Discord.
